upstream_status.dispute_points: (1) Very small window: the iteration body between the L177 read and the next L175 write contains global-memory loops, so a skeptic will say no failure was ever observed; but under happens-before it is a race. (2) The result of a lost read would be a wrong local_sum used in the gradient, i.e. real (if rare) numeric corruption. (3) A detector should treat the CTA-wide __syncthreads inside blockReduce as ordering the write->read only, not read->next-write.
